session_summary: Voss session (Mar 22): Major hardening pass. Pulled down the Hub database entirely — Agent, Identity, Room, Listener models replaced with three in-memory services (RouteCache, Identities from YAML, Rooms from Matrix). Fixed slug derivation (alias first via puppet queries), implicit routing (Matrix membership), invite auto-accept, DM slugs (dm-<other_user>). Replaced parse_mention regex with m.mentions. Built relay narration (Launching/Orienting/lifecycle messages as m.notice) + boot response delivery. Streaming responses (assistant messages sent to Matrix as they arrive). Attachment receiving (download from Synapse, save to pod, include in prompt). Three boot prompts (fresh/resume/baton) with per-channel baton paths. Manager build.sh rewritten for Router topology. Memory-based capacity (real podman stats, 15GB budget). Renamed kill→rescue throughout. Persistent stream buffers. Freeze→rescue fallback when relay unreachable. State 'dead'→'inactive'. Rescue button always visible. Relay sends identity+channel so Hub can reconstruct routes after restart.

decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations fossilized in the code. The architecture is proven, the code needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron out kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: Pods have internet via podman bridge default route. WG is for internal mesh only.

components.hub: Rails app on host. No database. Matrix appservice. Routes via m.mentions, puppets responses. Port 3100. Identity config from config/identities.yml. Route cache, room cache, resolving guard all in-memory. Queries Synapse as puppet users (bot not in every room).
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Spawns/freezes/rescues agents. Calls Router API. Provisions Forgejo. Port 9200 (mapped to 9201 on host). Memory-based capacity (15GB budget). build.sh handles full rebuild+peer+restart cycle.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Claude Code glue. Port 9300. Narrates lifecycle to Matrix (m.notice). Streams responses as they arrive. Sends identity+channel with every Hub request. Three boot prompts (fresh/resume/baton). Per-channel baton paths.

correction: Evans: 'We aren't deferring upgrades to the new version. This version needs to be feature complete, the rewrite is a cleanup not an opportunity to test new features.' Every design decision gets implemented and proven HERE first. The rewrite just removes the dead wood.

state_ownership.what: The relay owns all agent state. The Hub owns nothing. The Manager knows if the pod is running.

relay_states.starting: Pod up, relay listening, claude not invoked yet
relay_states.orienting: First claude invocation running (clone, read identity, read baton)
relay_states.busy: Claude running on a user message

state_ownership.silent_pod: Manager says pod is running but relay is unreachable. Not a state — a problem. Must be rescued.
state_ownership.hub_has_no_state: In-memory route cache with identity + room_id + slug per entry. Relay sends identity+channel with every request so Hub can reconstruct routes after restart.
state_ownership.manager_has_minimal_state: Manager knows: pod running or not. Capacity is memory-based (real podman stats). No pod count limits.

hub_routing.what: Hub route cache is in-memory. Routes + identity + room_id + slug per entry.
flow: 1. Message arrives, extract mention from m.mentions.user_ids
3. Have IP: deliver directly. If delivery fails, delete route, re-resolve
4. No IP: ask Manager to resolve → get IP → cache it → poll relay → deliver
5. Unaddressed message: check listeners (config), then sole-agent fallback (Matrix room membership)
hub_routing.room_resolution: Alias first (via puppet user query). Name is fallback only. Nil slug is an error. DMs derive from membership: dm-<other_user>.

relay_narration.what: The relay reports lifecycle events to Matrix as m.notice (dimmed, not agent's voice).

messages.orient_complete: Agent's own first words (m.text, not m.notice)

relay_narration.rule: The relay narrates, it doesn't impersonate. Agent words come from Claude only.

boot_prompts.what: Three boot states, three prompts. Manager determines state from Router registration + audit log.

states.fresh: Never registered on Router. First time in this channel.
states.resume: Previously frozen/crashed. Baton exists at sessions/<channel>/baton.json.
states.baton: Previous session sunsetted (context limit). Baton only, no session resume.

boot_prompts.mechanism: Manager passes boot_state in spawn.json. Relay reads it and picks the prompt.

synapse_as_subprocess.what: Synapse runs as a child process of the Hub.
synapse_as_subprocess.why: Synapse exponential backoff kills the pipeline when Hub restarts. Shared fate eliminates the window.

hub_as_systemd_service.what: Hub runs as a systemd service. neoclaw-rails-hub.service. Enabled on boot.

dm_slugs.what: DM rooms derive slugs as 'dm-<other_user>' from Matrix room membership.

error_messages_from_puppet.what: Errors come from the agent's puppet, not the system bot.
error_messages_from_puppet.why: The bot might not be in the room. The puppet is always auto-joined.

typing_watchdog.what: Relay checks /proc for running claude process every 20s. Types if running, clears if gone.
typing_watchdog.why: Don't trust state flags. Check reality.

capacity.what: Memory budget, not pod count. Default 15GB. Real usage from podman stats.
capacity.why: Idle agents cost ~15MB. Pod count caps solve a problem that doesn't exist.

what_works_proven: Full signal chain: @silas in Matrix → Hub → Manager → Router → pod → boot → clone → orient → respond → puppet back to Matrix
Hub stateless: no database, in-memory route cache, self-healing on failed delivery
Hub room resolution: canonical alias fetched from Synapse via puppet user
Hub implicit routing: sole agent in room via Matrix membership + invite auto-accept
Hub m.mentions routing: @mention works anywhere in message
DM slugs: silas-dm-evans instead of hash-based slugs
Relay narration: lifecycle messages visible in Matrix as m.notice
Boot response delivery: agent's first words reach Matrix
Streaming responses: assistant messages sent as they arrive
Attachment receiving: images/files downloaded and passed to Claude
Three boot prompts: fresh/resume/baton based on Manager state
Per-channel batons: sessions/<channel>/baton.json
Memory-based capacity: real podman stats, 15GB budget
Freeze→rescue fallback: unreachable relay triggers automatic rescue
Persistent stream buffers: survive Manager restart
Credentials: symlink chain from Claude Code auto-refresh → host → bind mount → pod
Session rescue: workspace + .claude copied out before pod replacement
Router API: register, activate, freeze, decommission, block
Forgejo provisioning: ephemeral user, SSH key cleanup, repo access
Puppet auto-join: agents join Matrix rooms before sending
Typing keepalive: 20s pulse while claude runs
things_that_bit_us: Synapse exponential backoff: Hub down for seconds → Synapse stops sending transactions for minutes.
Listeners on 'general' → route_to_listeners spawns ALL agents. Cascade.
Hub error messages come back through Synapse, trigger listeners, loop.
Inactive podman pods block new pods with same name. Must rm before run (with rescue).
Claude OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink, never copy.
Puppet users must be joined to Matrix rooms before sending. 403 otherwise.
Hub restart without env vars → complete silence. Needs systemd unit.
Room slug from display name vs canonical alias → wrong instance names. Alias MUST come first.
Appservice bot is NOT in every room. Room state queries must use puppet user_id parameter.
Never default slug to 'general'. Nil slug = error. Fallbacks hide problems.
Freeze with unreachable relay → container stuck in 'freezing' forever. Must fall back to rescue.
allow_browser Rails 8 feature rejects Turbo form submissions with 422. Remove for internal tools.
Manager rebuild rotates WG key — must re-peer with Router or Manager is unreachable.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. Inactive, not dead.
host_persistence_warning: nc-host WG interface and UFW rules do NOT survive host reboot. Need systemd unit.

agents.notes: All agents respond to @mentions only. No blanket listeners. Hopper is singleton. Everyone else gets instance-per-channel. Implicit routing: sole agent in a room gets all messages via Matrix membership check.

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Rescue from silent pods. No killing. States: starting → alive → freezing → inactive.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded.
philosophy.front_door: If it doesn't work through the front door, it's broken. Don't hide problems behind operator knowledge.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. Inactive, not dead. The relay narrates, it doesn't impersonate.
philosophy.no_fallbacks: Don't default to 'general'. Don't guess the slug. Don't hide errors behind reasonable-looking defaults. A wrong answer that looks right is worse than an error.
philosophy.capacity: Memory budget, not pod count. Idle agents are nearly free. Don't freeze agents to recover 15MB.
